timeline.text_cn: 移除了“减速雪球”射弹的命中判定体积加成。
从伤害至护甲的转化率从5%降低至3%。

timeline.text_en: Removed increased hitbox size on Slowball projectile.
Damage converted to Armor reduced to 3% (Down from 5%).

timeline.text_cn: 现在会对被击中的敌人造成减速。
现在可以长按辅助攻击模式对“冰锥”进行充能。充能的“冰锥”可以造成更多伤害，造成更强的减速效果，持续时间也更长。
伤害区间更改为15点至95点。
减速效果为最小5%，持续0.25秒，最大30%，持续1.5秒。

lines_cn: 被替换为“严寒冰刺”：靠近美的“冰墙”的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。

timeline.text_en: Secondary Fire can now be held down to charge up the icicle. Charged icicles deal more damage and inflict a stronger slow over a longer duration.
Damage changed to range from 15 to 95.
Slow scales from a minimum of 5% for 0.25s to a maximum of 30% for 1.5s.

lines_en: Replaced with Ice Spikes - Enemies near Mei's Ice Wall are damaged and slowed.

timeline.text_cn: 深度冰冻——主要威能 冰冻非重装英雄的速度加快30%。
冰冻非重装英雄的速度加快30%。
原效果：在[暴雪]内，每秒为你治疗15%总生命值。新效果：在[暴雪]内的盟友获得治疗，每秒治疗量为你最大总生命值的8%。
[冰霜冲击枪]主要攻击模式持续命中敌人会将其冰冻，持续0.75秒。
原效果：[冰霜冲击枪]的辅助攻击模式变为发射一枚雪球，命中使目标减速15%，暴击时使目标减速30%，持续1秒。新效果：使用技能或装置后，接下来的2发[冰锥]发射具有200%弹道速度的雪球，命中时施加30%减速。
毛线冬帽——史诗武器英雄物品
原效果：[暴雪]激活时，获得15%攻击速度。新效果：[暴雪]激活时，武器伤害提高20%。
坚固雪堡——稀有技能英雄物品
稀有度从史诗降低至稀有。
每根冰柱提供的技能强度从5%降低至4%。
生态监测站急冻舱——史诗技能英雄物品
雪地靴——稀有生存英雄物品
稀有度从史诗降低至稀有。
添加效果：25%生命值，5%移动速度。
在暴雪中也能触发效果。
长存冰盖——史诗生存英雄物品

timeline.text_en: Deep Freeze – Major Perk Freeze rate increased by 30% against non-tank heroes.
Freeze rate increased by 30% against non-tank heroes.
Reworked from "While within [Blizzard], heal 15% of your Life every second" to "Allies within [Blizzard] heal for 8% of your Max Life every 1s".
"Continuously hitting an enemy with [Endothermic Blaster]'s primary fire will Freeze them for 0.75s."

Reworked from "[Endothermic Blaster]'s secondary fire now shoots a snowball that applies 15% slow or 30% on critical hit for 1s" to "After using an ability or Gadget, your next 2 [Icicle] shots fire a snowball with 200% projectile speed that applies 30% slow on hit."
Himalayan Hat - Epic Hero Weapon Item
Reworked from "While [Blizzard] is activated, gain 15% Attack Speed" to "While [Blizzard] is activated, gain 20% increased Weapon Damage".
Sturdy Snowfort - Rare Hero Ability Item
Rarity changed to Rare (Down from Epic).
Ability Power per Pillar reduced to 4% (Down from 5%).
Ecopoint Cryobed - Epic Hero Ability Item
Rarity changed to Rare (Down from Epic).
Effect now also triggers in Blizzard.
Ice Sheet - Epic Hero Survival Item
Ice Wall's scale has been increased by 25%.
Moved to Tank role and Bruiser subrole.
No longer has the Specialist subrole passive.
Mei's scale has been increased by 25%.

timeline.text_cn: 移动至重装职责/斗士副职责。
不再具有专业副职责被动。

timeline.text_en: Damage per second increased from 100 to 110

lines_cn: 不再与“冰墙”共享冷却时间。
冷却时间从6秒延长至10秒。

lines_en: No longer shares a cooldown with Ice Wall.

timeline.text_cn: 新增：暴击现在改为施加30%减速效果。

lines_cn: 在“暴雪”内的盟友移动速度提高25%，且每秒治疗50点生命值。
二段跳会生成一根小型冰柱将美推至空中。

timeline.text_cn: 灭火寒霜——稀有生存英雄物品
添加效果：主要攻击模式会使空中的敌人减速35%，持续1.5秒。

lines_en: Allies within Blizzard gain 25% increased movement speed and heal for 50 health per second.
Double jumping creates a small ice pillar that launches Mei into the air.

timeline.text_en: Added: Primary fire applies 35% Slow for 1.5s to an airborne enemy.

timeline.text_cn: 现在辅助攻击模式以普通方式击中敌人时也会对命中的敌人造成减速。

timeline.text_en: Now normal hit with Secondary Fire will also apply slow to the hit enemy.

timeline.text_cn: 冰上加冰也会重置下一次“墙立一跳”的冷却时间。

timeline.text_en: Twice As Ice also resets next Snowball Flight's cooldown.

timeline.text_cn: “冰霜冲击枪”的主要攻击模式对“暴雪”内的敌人造成的伤害提高20%。
技能强度大于30%时，美的体型增大15%。
毛线冬帽——史诗武器英雄物品
攻击速度加快从10%提高至15%。

timeline.text_en: Endothermic Blaster's primary fire does 20% increased damage to enemies within Blizzard.
Increases Mei's size by 15% when above 30% ability power.
Himalayan Hat - Epic Weapon Hero Item
Increased Heal per second to 15% (up from 5%).
Reduced the knockback frequency rate by 60%.
Increased how far enemies are knocked back.
Increased the damage dealt per knockback to 20 (up from 10).

timeline.text_cn: 辅助攻击模式命中会使敌人减速20%，持续1.5秒。
主要攻击模式持续命中敌人会使其在短时间内冰冻。

timeline.text_en: Secondary fire hits slow enemies by 20% for 1.5 seconds.
Continuously hitting enemies with primary fire freezes them for a short time.
Mei can now move during Cryo-Freeze.

timeline.text_cn: 现在会制造一场小型“暴雪”。
美现在可以在使用“急冻”期间移动。
不再增加“冰墙”的冷却时间。

timeline.text_en: No longer increases cooldown of Ice Wall.
Primary Fire's range is increased by 30%.
Ice Wall's duration and cooldown are increased by 2 seconds.
Cryo-Freeze slows and deals 70 damage per second to nearby enemies.
Secondary fire base projectile size reduced from 0.15 to 0.12 meters.
Secondary fire damage increased from 75 to 85.
Press Jump in the Air to activate.
Creates a large Ice Pillar under Mei.
Heal per second increased from 50 to 62.5.
Damage per second increased from 70 to 100.
Now immediately slows enemies by 40% instead of building up over time.
Cryo-freeze Cancel Input – All by default.
Damage increased from 65 to 70 per second.
Duration before slow falls off between primary fire hits increased from 0.5 to 0.6 seconds.
timeline.metric: duration before slow falls off between primary fire hits

timeline.text_en: Bonus damage can now also be triggered with Mei's quick melee.
Primary fire damage per second increased from 55 to 100.
Maximum slow applied by primary fire reduced from 50% to 40%.
Primary fire damage per second increased from 55 to 70.
Maximum slow applied when this effect activates reduced from 75% to 65%.
Damage per second reduced from 100 to 55.
Primary fire slow is no longer always 40% and now scales from 30-50%.
Primary fire impacts now build up to a slowing effect that sticks to the enemy target for 1.5 seconds and slows them for 75%.
Secondary fire impacts can detonate this new slow effect, dealing an additional 40 damage.
Cyro-Freeze can now be canceled by pressing the ability’s button again
Hold To Use Cryo-Freeze - Off by default
Hide Cyro-Freeze Cancel Text - Off by default
Hide Cryo-Freeze Timer - Off by default
Default Ice Wall Rotation - Horizontal by default
Ice Wall Confirmation Input - Primary Fire by default
Blizzard ultimate cast time reduced from 0.5 to 0.4 seconds
Can now be manually destroyed while dead
Now behaves like Mei’s Ice Wall when it comes to interactions. Cryo-Freeze will block line of sight and collision in much the same way
Freeze stun duration lowered from 1.5 to 1.3 seconds
Player collision now allows large heroes to fit through 1 pillar gaps
